name: lemeng.item_profit.l0.3120
_note: 乐檬 AMAREPORT itemprofitanalysis（商品毛利分析）——写湖 lemeng/item_profit/system_book=<book>/bizday=<day>/all.parquet。
①【身份自证（fail-closed）】whoami → company_id == SYSTEM_BOOK、env BRANCH_NUMS ⊆ whoami branch_nums；任一不满足拒采。
②【分块扇出】AMAREPORT 硬约束：branch_nums 必填、单请求 ≤100 家、日期窗 ≤31 天。
⇒ drv 按 whoami 名单切块（floor(rn/100.0)），ctl.foreach 逐块调子管线 lemeng.item_profit.day。
③【汇总闸】子管线每块写 .duckle-stage/item_profit/chunk-<batch_id>-<n>.parquet；父侧只认本次 batch_id，
断块数/门店数一致 → qa.contract → 才写湖。
④【回填】同一条管线换时间窗（gen-backfill-variants.mjs 派生 ${BIZDAY} 变体）。

properties.sql:
SELECT 'book' AS violation, company_id AS detail, 'company_id must equal SYSTEM_BOOK' AS rule
FROM input
WHERE company_id IS DISTINCT FROM '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'branch_not_permitted' AS violation, CAST(c.branch_num AS VARCHAR) AS detail, 'env BRANCH_NUMS ⊆ whoami branch_nums' AS rule
FROM (SELECT unnest('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}'::BIGINT[]) AS branch_num) c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT unnest(CAST(json_extract(branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[])) AS branch_num FROM input) w USING (branch_num)
WHERE w.branch_num IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'whoami_empty' AS violation, '0' AS detail, 'whoami branch_nums must be non-empty' AS rule
FROM input WHERE len(CAST(json_extract(branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[])) = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BRANCH_NUMS' AS violation, '${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}' AS detail, 'JSON integer array, e.g. [1001,1002]' AS rule
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}', '\[[0-9]+([, ]+[0-9]+)*\]')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SYSTEM_BOOK' AS violation, '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS detail, 'digits only' AS rule
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}', '[0-9]{1,32}')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BIZDAY' AS violation, '${date-1d}' AS detail, 'YYYY-MM-DD' AS rule
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${date-1d}', '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')

properties.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "drv" AS
WITH w AS (
  SELECT unnest(CAST(json_extract(branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[])) AS bn FROM "d0"
),
n AS (SELECT bn, CAST(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bn) - 1 AS INTEGER) AS rn FROM w),
-- floor(rn / 100.0)：DuckDB 的 `/` 返回 DOUBLE，CAST 取整是四舍五入；整数除法会错切（148 -> 51/97）。
c AS (SELECT CAST(floor(rn / 100.0) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS chunk_no, bn FROM n),
j AS (SELECT chunk_no,
             '[' || string_agg(CAST(bn AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY bn) || ']' AS branch_nums_json,
             CAST(count(*) AS INTEGER) AS n_branches
      FROM c GROUP BY chunk_no),
m AS (SELECT CAST(count(*) AS INTEGER) AS n_chunks FROM j)
SELECT CAST('${date-1d}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST('${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       strftime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ') AS batch_id,
       CAST(j.chunk_no AS INTEGER) AS chunk_no,
       CAST(j.branch_nums_json AS VARCHAR) AS branch_nums_json,
       j.n_branches,
       m.n_chunks,
       '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}-${date-1d}-c' || CAST(j.chunk_no AS VARCHAR) AS item_key
FROM j CROSS JOIN m
ORDER BY j.chunk_no

SELECT CAST(cur.batch_id AS VARCHAR) AS batch_id,
       CAST(cur.system_book AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST(cur.bizday AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(cur.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(cur.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(cur.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(cur.item_num AS INTEGER) AS item_num,
       CAST(cur.item_code AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
       CAST(cur.item_barcode AS VARCHAR) AS item_barcode,
       CAST(cur.item_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
       CAST(cur.item_spec AS VARCHAR) AS item_spec,
       CAST(cur.item_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_unit,
       CAST(cur.sale_num AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS sale_num,
       CAST(cur.sale_count AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS sale_count,
       CAST(cur.customer_nums AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS customer_nums,
       CAST(cur.sale_money AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS sale_money,
       CAST(cur.sale_money_no_coupon AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS sale_money_no_coupon,
       CAST(cur.sale_cost AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS sale_cost,
       CAST(cur.profit_money AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS profit_money,
       CAST(cur.profit_rate AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS profit_rate,
       CAST(cur.profit_money_no_coupon AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS profit_money_no_coupon,
       CAST(cur.profit_rate_no_coupon AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS profit_rate_no_coupon,
       CAST(cur.computed_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at,
       CAST(cur.file_chunk AS INTEGER) AS file_chunk,
       CAST(cur.chunk_n_matched AS INTEGER) AS chunk_n_matched,
       CAST(e.n_chunks AS INTEGER) AS exp_n_chunks,
       CAST(e.n_branches AS INTEGER) AS exp_n_branches
FROM (
  SELECT *, regexp_extract(filename, 'chunk-([0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z)-([0-9]+)\.parquet$', 1) AS file_batch,
            CAST(regexp_extract(filename, 'chunk-([0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z)-([0-9]+)\.parquet$', 2) AS INTEGER) AS file_chunk
  FROM read_parquet('/workspace/.duckle-stage/item_profit/*.parquet', filename = true)
) cur
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT any_value(batch_id) AS batch_id,
         max(CAST(n_chunks AS INTEGER)) AS n_chunks,
         sum(CAST(n_branches AS INTEGER)) AS n_branches
  FROM input
) e
WHERE cur.file_batch = e.batch_id
